notes: Each event has six phrasings. expect.post lists [kind, amount, account] that must be posted when the case is ready; kind is cash-out, cash-in, obligation-payable, obligation-receivable, settlement-payable, settlement-receivable or transfer. expect.forbid lists amounts that must never be posted. expect.outcomes lists acceptable case routes. expect.amounts lists [value, status] the understanding must contain. oracle is a hand-written correct understanding for the formal phrasing only; it tests everything after the model, not the model. ledger.capitalizationThreshold stands for an office that has approved its own threshold.
